chunks: When We cancel a message (sent to an earlier prophet) or throw it into oblivion, We replace it with one better or one similar. Do you not know that God has power over all things?

key_terms.نَسْخ: Abrogation, cancellation, or replacement of a divine ruling or verse
key_terms.نُنْسِهَا: We cause it to be forgotten or cast into oblivion

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of abrogation (Naskh) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the principle of divine abrogation (naskh), where God replaces earlier rulings with superior or equivalent ones to accommodate changing circumstances, affirming His omnipotence. This concept is often linked to the gradual revelation of laws, illustrating how divine wisdom adapts to human capacity while maintaining the coherence of the Quranic message.
